basis: Krig Computer Vision Metrics: Survey, Taxonomy, and Analysis
Modern Edge-AI / MLOps Platform Architecture Patterns
design_principles: Hardware-Aware: Every descriptor knows its optimal compute substrate
Context-Aware: Every descriptor declares its environmental preconditions
Multimodal-Ready: Every descriptor declares fusion and sensor-dropout behavior

ideal_operations: Graph search and tree traversal (KD-Tree, Vocabulary Tree)
Database matching and geometric constraint solving

memory_hierarchy.access_pattern_strength: Coalesced contiguous access, texture-cache spatial locality, scatter-gather via texture units

ideal_operations: Dense pixel-wise transforms (color space conversion, histogram equalization)

memory_hierarchy.access_pattern_strength: Streaming tensor access, minimal random access

instruction_sets.sensor_isp: Hardware demosaic, AWB, noise reduction, lens shading correction

memory_hierarchy.access_pattern_strength: Streaming line-buffer, circular buffer, high-bandwidth sequential

ideal_operations: Point operations (LUT, contrast remap, vignette correction)

instruction_sets.custom_pipeline: Fully custom datapath synthesized from RTL/HLS
instruction_sets.streaming: Line-buffered pixel streaming with zero external memory

ideal_operations: Bitwise operations for binary descriptors (Hamming popcount)

low.description: In-register or L1-cache resident, no external memory traffic
examples: Binary descriptor Hamming via SIMD popcount

high.description: Scatter-gather, random access, large working set

application_lifecycle_states.calibration: System is being calibrated; accuracy prioritized over speed
application_lifecycle_states.warmup: Initial frames; models loading, caches cold
application_lifecycle_states.steady_state: Normal operation; all caches warm, models loaded
application_lifecycle_states.degraded: One or more sensors or compute units unavailable
application_lifecycle_states.drift_detected: Statistical monitoring indicates feature distribution shift
application_lifecycle_states.recovery: Re-initializing after failure or drift correction

automotive.implication: Deterministic execution, worst-case timing analysis required

consumer.implication: Best-effort, optimize for UX and battery

privacy_impact_levels.none: Descriptor captures no PII (e.g., edge gradients, texture)
privacy_impact_levels.low: Descriptor could theoretically reconstruct coarse scene (e.g., global histogram)
privacy_impact_levels.medium: Descriptor captures spatially localized identifiable patterns (e.g., local keypoints near face)
privacy_impact_levels.high: Descriptor is a direct biometric embedding (e.g., face embedding, gait signature)

early_fusion.description: Raw sensor data concatenated before feature extraction
early_fusion.example: RGB+Depth stacked as 4-channel input to CNN

mid_fusion.description: Features extracted per-modality then fused at intermediate layers
mid_fusion.example: RGB CNN features + Depth CNN features concatenated at layer 3
mid_fusion.accuracy_impact: high, robust to partial calibration error

late_fusion.description: Independent per-modality decisions combined at output
late_fusion.example: RGB classifier score + LiDAR classifier score averaged
late_fusion.accuracy_impact: moderate, very robust to sensor dropout

attention_fusion.description: Cross-modal attention mechanism dynamically weights modalities
attention_fusion.example: Transformer cross-attention between RGB tokens and LiDAR tokens

geometric_fusion.description: 3D geometric constraints used to associate features across modalities
geometric_fusion.example: Project LiDAR points onto RGB, associate SIFT keypoints with 3D coordinates

calibration_requirements.intrinsic: Per-sensor lens distortion, focal length, principal point
calibration_requirements.extrinsic: Rigid body transform (R,t) between sensor coordinate frames
calibration_requirements.temporal: Timestamp synchronization accuracy (hardware trigger vs. software NTP)
calibration_requirements.photometric: Cross-sensor radiometric/color calibration for consistent appearance

dropout_resilience_strategies.graceful_degradation: Fall back to single-modality pipeline with reduced accuracy
dropout_resilience_strategies.synthetic_modality: Generate missing modality via learned model (e.g., monocular depth estimation)
dropout_resilience_strategies.temporal_bridging: Use last known good sensor reading with IMU dead-reckoning
dropout_resilience_strategies.uncertainty_propagation: Increase covariance in fusion filter to down-weight missing modality

primary_affinity.reason: Binary descriptor extraction is bitwise XOR + popcount, perfectly maps to SIMD integer units

secondary_affinity.reason: Popcount and XOR are trivially implementable in LUTs with single-cycle latency

hardware_aware.gpu_suitability: Poor — binary operations waste SIMT floating-point throughput; Hamming distance not natively accelerated
hardware_aware.npu_suitability: None — NPU expects tensor operations, not bitwise logic
hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: Low bandwidth — in-register SIMD, L1-cache-friendly sequential keypoint scan
hardware_aware.cross_platform_determinism: High — integer bitwise ops produce identical results across CPU/FPGA

required_preprocessing.dependency_dag: Raw → Gaussian_Blur → FAST_Detector → Orientation_Assignment → BRIEF_Pair_Sampling → BitVector

quality_degradation_handling.motion_blur: Degrades significantly — binary pairs become unstable
quality_degradation_handling.compression_artifacts: Moderate tolerance — binary thresholding absorbs some block noise

privacy_impact.reason: Local gradient direction bits carry no reconstructable semantic content

safety_integrity.reason: Deterministic integer ops, but no formal robustness guarantee under adversarial perturbation

drift_detection.method: Monitor mean Hamming distance of matched pairs over sliding window; spike indicates scene change or degradation
drift_detection.threshold_suggestion: Mean Hamming > 80 (out of 256) suggests distribution shift

context_aware.temporal_stability: Medium — keypoint locations jitter 1-3 pixels frame-to-frame without sub-pixel refinement

sensor_dropout_resilience.fallback: Continue with monochrome channel only if RGB fails

multimodal_ready.cross_modal_matching: Not natively supported — binary pairs are intensity-relative; cross-modal requires retraining pairs on target modality

primary_affinity.reason: Scale-space DoG pyramid requires sequential octave construction; histogram binning benefits from SIMD float ops

secondary_affinity.reason: Gaussian blur and gradient computation are embarrassingly parallel area operations
secondary_affinity.caveat: Scale-space pyramid requires inter-kernel synchronization between octaves

hardware_aware.npu_suitability: Low — SIFT is not a neural network; NPU cannot accelerate DoG or histogram binning efficiently

quantization_cascade.notes: L1-normalize then sqrt, then quantize; Hellinger distance in INT8 approximates L2 in FP32

hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: High bandwidth — scale-space pyramid requires multiple full-image buffers; scatter-gather for keypoint localization
hardware_aware.cross_platform_determinism: Low — floating-point DoG extrema interpolation varies across architectures; GPU atomic ordering non-deterministic
compiler_optimization_hints: Use separable Gaussian filter (2x 1D instead of 2D)
Pre-compute octave images in tiled memory layout

mandatory: None (SIFT includes its own Gaussian pyramid)
required_preprocessing.dependency_dag: Raw → Grayscale → Gaussian_Pyramid → DoG → Extrema_Detection → Subpixel_Localization → Orientation_Histogram → 4x4_Gradient_Histograms → L2_Normalize

quality_degradation_handling.defocus_blur: Moderate tolerance — scale-space absorbs some blur
quality_degradation_handling.motion_blur: Moderate tolerance — dominant orientation may shift but descriptor remains matchable
quality_degradation_handling.compression_artifacts: High tolerance — gradient histograms smooth over block boundaries

privacy_impact.reason: Gradient histograms are not directly reconstructable to recognizable imagery, but spatial layout of keypoints could leak coarse scene structure

safety_integrity.reason: Floating-point non-determinism, no worst-case timing guarantee for variable keypoint count

drift_detection.method: Track keypoint count per frame and mean descriptor L2 norm; sudden drop in count or norm shift indicates degradation
drift_detection.threshold_suggestion: Keypoint count < 50% of running average triggers alert

context_aware.temporal_stability: High — sub-pixel localization and scale-space provide stable keypoint positions across frames

sensor_dropout_resilience.fallback: Switch to ORB if compute budget insufficient for SIFT

multimodal_ready.cross_modal_matching: Partially supported — gradient structure is similar across RGB/NIR; fails for RGB-to-Thermal without domain adaptation

ip_and_community.community_adoption: Extremely High — de facto gold standard

primary_affinity.reason: VGG-style encoder backbone maps perfectly to NPU systolic array Conv2D

secondary_affinity.estimated_throughput: 120 FPS @ 640x480 on NVIDIA Jetson Orin GPU

hardware_aware.cpu_suitability: Poor for real-time — VGG backbone is too deep for CPU latency targets; acceptable for offline
hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: Medium — CNN feature maps are tile-friendly; NMS post-processing is serial
hardware_aware.cross_platform_determinism: Medium — INT8 quantization rounding varies by vendor; FP32 is deterministic within same framework
compiler_optimization_hints: TensorRT INT8 calibration with 500 representative images

required_preprocessing.dependency_dag: Raw → Resize → Normalize → VGG_Encoder → Detector_Head + Descriptor_Head → NMS → Top-K_Selection

fails_under: dark (<5 lux) unless trained on dark data

quality_degradation_handling.defocus_blur: Moderate — learned features are somewhat robust
quality_degradation_handling.compression_artifacts: High tolerance — CNN features are inherently denoising
recommended_mitigation: Fine-tune on target domain if degradation is systematic

privacy_impact.reason: 256-D learned embedding captures semantic content; research shows scene reconstruction from deep descriptors is possible

safety_integrity.reason: Neural network — no formal robustness guarantee, non-deterministic under quantization

drift_detection.method: Monitor descriptor cosine similarity distribution over time; distribution shift indicates domain drift
drift_detection.threshold_suggestion: KL divergence of descriptor norm histogram > 0.1 triggers re-calibration alert

context_aware.temporal_stability: High — learned detector produces very stable keypoint locations; sub-pixel via soft-argmax

sensor_dropout_resilience.fallback: If RGB fails, use monocular depth estimation to generate pseudo-depth, or fall back to ORB on last good frame

multimodal_ready.cross_modal_matching: Supported via fine-tuning — SuperPoint can be trained on RGB+Thermal pairs for cross-modal matching

ip_and_community.community_adoption: Very High — dominant in modern SLAM and SfM

primary_affinity.reason: KD-Tree neighbor search is pointer-chasing (CPU strength); angular histogram binning is SIMD-friendly

secondary_affinity.reason: Parallel normal estimation and SPFH computation per point
secondary_affinity.caveat: KD-Tree on GPU requires specialized structures (e.g., FLANN GPU)

hardware_aware.npu_suitability: None — point cloud operations are not tensor operations
hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: High — KD-Tree traversal is scatter-gather; point cloud is unstructured
hardware_aware.cross_platform_determinism: Medium — KD-Tree tie-breaking order varies; FP32 math is deterministic within same arch
compiler_optimization_hints: Use FLANN or nanoflann for KD-Tree

quality_degradation_handling.sensor_noise: Moderate — normal estimation smooths some noise
quality_degradation_handling.missing_data: Moderate — FPFH only uses available neighbors
recommended_mitigation: Apply bilateral filter to depth map before point cloud generation

privacy_impact.reason: 3D angular histograms carry no recognizable visual content

safety_integrity.reason: Deterministic math on point clouds, but variable neighbor count makes worst-case timing hard to bound

drift_detection.method: Monitor mean nearest-neighbor distance in FPFH space; increasing distance suggests sensor calibration drift
drift_detection.threshold_suggestion: Mean FPFH L2 distance to database > 2x baseline triggers recalibration

context_aware.temporal_stability: High — 3D geometry is stable; jitter comes only from sensor noise

extendable_to: RGB (via RGB-D point cloud with color)

sensor_dropout_resilience.fallback: If LiDAR drops, use stereo depth with IMU dead-reckoning to maintain point cloud stream

multimodal_ready.cross_modal_matching: Supported — FPFH on LiDAR point cloud can match FPFH on stereo point cloud if both are metrically calibrated

primary_affinity.reason: Moment computation is a serial accumulation over contour pixels; low parallelism

secondary_affinity.reason: Connected component labeling and contour tracing can be parallelized across regions

hardware_aware.npu_suitability: None — not a neural network operation

quantization_cascade.notes: Hu moments require double precision due to log-scale values
Not recommended — precision loss in log domain

hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: Low — operates on segmented region, typically small pixel count
hardware_aware.cross_platform_determinism: High — moment formulas are deterministic; FP64 ensures identical results
compiler_optimization_hints: Use log-transformed Hu moments for numerical stability
Pre-compute centroid and central moments in single pass

required_preprocessing.dependency_dag: Raw → Color_Space_Conv → Threshold/Segment → Morphology → Contour_Trace → Raw_Moments → Central_Moments → Hu_Moments

quality_degradation_handling.compression_artifacts: Degrades — block artifacts create false contours

privacy_impact.reason: 7 scalar moment values carry no reconstructable visual content

safety_integrity.reason: Deterministic FP64 math, fixed 7-element output, bounded computation time per contour

drift_detection.method: Monitor Hu moment distribution of known reference objects; shift indicates camera calibration or lighting drift
drift_detection.threshold_suggestion: Hu moment L2 distance from reference > 0.01 triggers recalibration

context_aware.temporal_stability: High for rigid objects under controlled conditions; low otherwise

sensor_dropout_resilience.fallback: Switch to thermal silhouette if RGB segmentation fails

multimodal_ready.cross_modal_matching: Supported — Hu moments on RGB silhouette can match Hu moments on thermal silhouette for shape-based recognition

ip_and_community.community_adoption: High in industrial inspection, biology; low in modern CV

primary_affinity.reason: 4D histogram binning over volumetric grid is massively parallel; surface normal computation is area operation

secondary_affinity.reason: Fallback for systems without GPU; 3D grid traversal is cache-unfriendly but parallelizable across voxels

hardware_aware.npu_suitability: Low — not a standard CNN; could be approximated as 3D CNN but loses polychron structure
hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: Extreme — 4D volume requires multiple depth frames buffered; histogram scatter is random
hardware_aware.cross_platform_determinism: Medium — floating-point histogram accumulation order varies with thread scheduling
compiler_optimization_hints: Use 3D texture memory for volume access
Shared memory for local histogram accumulation
Pre-compute surface normals in separate kernel

quality_degradation_handling.depth_noise: Moderate — normal estimation smooths some noise
quality_degradation_handling.missing_depth: Low — holes in depth map create undefined normals

privacy_impact.reason: Captures human body motion patterns; gait and activity are identifiable biometrics

safety_integrity.reason: High-dimensional non-deterministic descriptor, no worst-case timing guarantee

drift_detection.method: Monitor depth sensor noise floor and normal estimation quality; increasing noise indicates sensor degradation
drift_detection.threshold_suggestion: Mean normal estimation residual > 15 degrees triggers sensor recalibration

context_aware.temporal_stability: High — captures temporal dynamics inherently; stable across repeated actions

sensor_dropout_resilience.fallback: If depth sensor fails, fall back to 2D optical flow + HOG as degraded action recognition

multimodal_ready.cross_modal_matching: Not applicable — HON4D is a classification descriptor, not a matching descriptor

ip_and_community.community_adoption: Moderate — influential in action recognition, superseded by deep learning

mobile_ar_6dof_tracking.description: Real-time 6DOF camera pose tracking on battery-powered mobile/wearable device

industrial_quality_inspection.description: Fixed-camera manufacturing line inspecting part geometry and surface color

autonomous_vehicle_perception.description: Multi-sensor fusion for object detection, tracking, and scene understanding

medical_surgical_guidance.description: Real-time tissue tracking and instrument pose estimation during minimally invasive surgery

satellite_earth_observation.description: Multi-spectral change detection and object recognition from orbital imagery

actions.reason: Phase-based descriptors are invariant to uniform blur
Non-deterministic descriptor not permitted at ASIL-C+

fme_score.description: Feature Metric Evaluation — composite score balancing discrimination power against compute/memory cost
fme_score.interpretation: Higher is better; enables cross-family comparison (e.g., ORB vs SIFT vs SuperPoint)
